title: GraphAnalysis
description: DRAFT for review by Person 3. The 200 answer of the Graph Service for GET /analyze/{address} (alias GET /analysis/{address}), from docs/graph-analysis-proposal.md and checked against services/graph/app/service.py. Every address and cluster id is lower-case. A non-200 answer has the shape in $defs/GraphError. Not checked here: that an exit point is left out of members (app/service.py does this; JSON Schema cannot compare two arrays).

clusterId.description: The target's own cluster. For a wallet that is not a member but is a link candidate: the cluster it is most connected to. null if neither.

behaviorScore.description: The wallet's own behavior score; weights and thresholds come from config/scoring.json

signals.description: Only the signals that fired. Passed unmodified into the evidence bundle.

metrics.description: Every measured value behind the score, in the order the service returns them. A value is null when it cannot be measured for that wallet (for example hopsToExit with no path to an exit point).

members.description: Cluster members, without the exit points; [] when the target is not in a cluster

exitPoints.description: Exit points of the target's own cluster; [] when the target is not in a cluster

dataSource.description: The backend refuses to build evidence if this differs from its DATA_SOURCE

link.description: Only for a wallet judged as a link candidate. The facts the graph decided.

linked.description: Only for a link candidate. The graph's own verdict; the verifier records it and does not use it to decide.

reason.description: Only for a link candidate. The graph's reason for linked.

repeatedStructuredOutflowToCluster.description: sends funds into the cluster or its exit points in a repeated, structured way

forwardsOnwardLikeMember.description: forwards funds onward the way a cluster member does

isKnownVictim.description: a known victim of the cluster: never linked

isOneOffPayer.description: paid the cluster once and nothing more: never linked

GraphError.description: The body of a non-200 answer (400 bad address, 404 no data, 502 graph failure). FastAPI's own 404 for an unknown route has the same shape with detail "Not Found".
